name: Web API
description: Calls the HTTP API of your own app or service. Reads freely, changes only with your OK.
guide: Enter the base address of your API, for example `https://api.example.com/v1`. Every call stays under this address.
If your API needs a key, enter the header name (often `Authorization`, with a value like `Bearer abc123`, or `X-Api-Key`) and the secret value. Leave both empty if it is open.
Press **Test connection**. It sends a GET request to the test path (the base address itself if you leave it empty).

setup.label: Base address
setup.help: Calls can only go to this address and below.

setup.label: Key header name
setup.help: The name of the header that carries your key. Leave empty if none.

setup.label: Key value
setup.help: The full header value, for example: Bearer abc123

setup.label: Test path
setup.help: A path that answers when everything works.
